issues.description: _PARAM_VALUE_DELIMITERS conflates literal delimiter characters with OpenAPI symbolic style names in one namespace.
issues.detail: The dict mixes identity entries (',' -> ',', '|' -> '|', ' ' -> ' ') with alias entries ('pipeDelimited' -> '|', 'spaceDelimited' -> ' '). Split into an allowed-char set plus a small alias map ({'pipeDelimited': '|', 'spaceDelimited': ' '}); resolution becomes alias.get(d, d) with one membership check. Same behavior, cleaner precondition, prevents future char/name collisions.

issues.description: ValueError on unsupported delimiter is undocumented and conflates programmer error with client error.
issues.detail: The Raises clause only lists HTTPBadRequest, but an unsupported delimiter now raises bare ValueError mid-request. Since the method's convention converts transform ValueErrors into HTTPBadRequest, a developer mistake risks surfacing as a 400. Use a distinct exception (TypeError) or validate at the boundary, and document the behavior in the Raises section.

issues.description: delimiter silently no-ops when the param already arrived as a multi-instance list.
issues.detail: When the same param appears multiple times, items is already a list and delimiter is silently ignored. A caller requesting '|' splitting on ?x=a|b&x=c|d gets ['a|b','c|d']. The behavior is mentioned in a Note but weakens the postcondition. Either also split list elements, reject the combination, or state the contract explicitly.

issues.description: Missing tests for boundary cases: empty values, adjacent/trailing delimiters, missing-param + delimiter, transform interaction.
issues.detail: Tests cover happy paths and the unsupported-delimiter rejection but do not pin: empty-segment behavior ('a,,b'), default returned when param missing with delimiter set, delimiter combined with transform, keep_blank_qs_values interaction, or the unchanged default (delimiter=None) regression. Add small tests so the contract is locked rather than demonstrated by example.

issues.description: Empty-segment and blank-token semantics after split are undocumented.
issues.detail: str.split preserves empty segments ('a,,b' -> ['a','','b']) and the docstring only notes that keep_blank_qs_values does not affect secondary splitting. State the invariant explicitly: empty segments between delimiters are preserved as empty strings. A reader should not need to run the code to learn this.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the patch is small, well-scoped, and the implementation is correct on the happy paths — but the specification layer is sloppy. The central issue, flagged by all six reviewers, is that _PARAM_VALUE_DELIMITERS mixes literal delimiter characters and OpenAPI symbolic style names in one dict, with three redundant identity entries; it should be decomposed into an allowed-char set plus a small alias map. Secondary consensus: the ValueError raised for an invalid delimiter is undocumented and conflates programmer error with client error on the same channel that converts to HTTPBadRequest, and the silent no-op when the value is already a list weakens the postcondition. Tests demonstrate examples but do not pin boundary cases (empty segments, missing-param + delimiter, transform interaction). NEEDS-WORK on the cleanups; lands after.
